This document guides AI agents contributing to the `umami-kotlin` repository. `umami-kotlin` is a Kotlin Multiplatform library wrapping the Umami web analytics REST API. Goal: type-safe, asynchronous, easy-to-use Kotlin interface across platforms (Android, iOS, JVM, etc.).

Modules: `:umami` (core), `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`.
`:umami` packages: `api` (Umami REST comms), `core` (HTTP client + event queue), `domain` (data models/value objects like `Hostname`, `Ip`).

Networking: Ktor for all HTTP; multiplatform via different engines per target (e.g., `OkHttp` for Android/JVM, `Darwin` for iOS).
Async: Kotlinx Coroutines (esp. event queue). Serialization: Kotlinx Serialization.
Time: `kotlin.time.Instant` for all date/time.
Logging: Kermit.
Testing: Kotest for assertions in tests. All new tests should use Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) instead of `kotlin.test` assertions.
Mocks: Mokkery.
Patterns: Builder Pattern (`UmamiOptionsBuilder`), Facade Pattern (main `Umami`), Producer-Consumer Pattern (Kotlin `Channel` queue + background coroutine sending to Umami API).

Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
Build: Gradle. IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition or Android Studio.
Static analysis tools:
1) Detekt config `detekt/detekt.yml` (runs automatically before git push).
2) Qlty config `.qlty/qlty.toml`.
Do not introduce new static analysis issues.

Code coverage enforced by Kover; minima defined in root `build.gradle.kts`. Run coverage check with: (command not provided).

Rules: All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug.
Verification: run JVM tests for the modified module using `jvmTest`:
./gradlew :umami:jvmTest
./gradlew :umami-api:jvmTest
./gradlew :sample:terminalApp:jvmTest
CI performs full compilation/integration (including Android).

Docs: Dokka (`./gradlew dokkaHtml`).
Publishing: Maven Central via `maven-publish`.

This is a living document; update if significant architectural/build changes occur.
